news.title: Man picking up debris loses hand after blast on California beach, family says
news.description: The family says the man was walking along the beach picking up discarded fireworks and other trash when he picked up what they described as a "bomb-like device" that unexpectedly exploded.

news.title: Judge orders Indian billionaire to answer questions on whether was quid pro quo
news.description: The Justice Department in May announced it had dismissed criminal foreign bribery and securities fraud charges against Gautam Adani, India's richest man.

news.title: Here's who's vying to replace Graham Platner as Maine Democratic Senate nominee
news.description: Graham Platner's move to suspend his Senate campaign after a sexual assault allegation has prompted a mad dash in Maine, as Democrats position themselves as replacements to take on GOP Sen. Susan Collins.

news.title: Firm hired to check air quality after L.A. warehouse fire has controversial history
news.description: Arkansas-based Onterris reported "good" air quality after a giant warehouse fire in Los Angeles. Some experts and activists say the testing is inadequate.

news.title: American-made drone technology guiding Ukraine's strikes into Russia
news.description: American-made drone technology is helping guide Ukrainian strikes further into Russia, despite the U.S. walking back some of its military support for Ukraine. CBS News international reporter Aiden Stretch has more.

news.title: Stock market up after AI chipmakers rebound and oil dips
news.description: AI chipmakers rebounded from a selloff and oil prices dipped Thursday, sending the stock market surging. CBS News MoneyWatch correspondent Kelly O'Grady reports.

news.title: Maine Democrats to hold nominating convention after Platner exit
news.description: Until Wednesday night, Graham Platner was the Democratic nominee seeking to unseat Maine's Republican Sen. Susan Collins. He exited the Maine race after a credible allegation surfaced that he raped a former romantic partner, which he denies. CBS News congressional correspondent Caitlin Huey-Burns has the latest.

news.title: The 2026 FIFA World Cup schedule and how to watch
news.description: With 104 World Cup games being played in the U.S., Canada and Mexico, it's like "a Super Bowl every single day for five weeks," U.S. team captain Tim Ream told CBS News.

news.title: Home prices across the U.S. hit an all-time high
news.description: Sky-high housing prices make even starter homes too expensive for most Americans, housing data show.

news.title: What we know about Trump's decision to switch Air Force One planes
news.description: CBS News has learned that the Secret Service advised President Trump not to take the Qatari-donated Air Force One to leave the NATO summit in Turkey. CBS News' Nicole Sganga and Samantha Vinograd join with the latest.

news.title: U.S. and Iran escalate exchange of strikes
news.description: The U.S. and Iran had significant escalations in fighting this week. The U.S. military launched more strikes on Thursday than at any other point since a fragile ceasefire was established between the two countries. CBS News senior national security correspondent Charlie D'Agata reports.

news.title: Trump did not use Qatar-gifted Air Force One as he left Turkey due to possible security concerns
news.description: President Trump did not use his new Qatari-gifted Air Force One when he left the NATO summit in Turkey this week due to possible security concerns, CBS News has learned. CBS News homeland security correspondent Nicole Sganga has more.

news.title: Potential Platner replacement Jordan Wood says voters are "deeply betrayed and hurt"
news.description: Maine Senate candidate Graham Platner is expected to officially drop out as the Democratic nominee on Monday following a sexual abuse scandal. Potential replacement Jordan Wood joins "The Takeout" to lay out what happens next.

news.title: Affordable Care Act enrollment drops by nearly 3 million as costs rise after subsidies expire
news.description: New federal data shows that Affordable Care Act enrollments are down by nearly 3 million people. Premiums jumped at the start of 2026 after Congress let COVID-era federal subsidies expire. CBS News medical correspondent Dr. Céline Gounder joins with analysis.

news.title: A look at some candidates vying for Graham Platner's Democratic nomination for Senate
news.description: Maine Democratic Senate candidate Graham Platner told his staff he will not file paperwork to officially withdraw from his race until Monday, the last day to do so. Platner said he was dropping out on Wednesday night, days after a former girlfriend accused him of sexually assaulting her in 2021. CBS News congressional correspondent Caitlin Huey-Burns has more from Portland.

news.title: National Weather Service operating with less experienced staff, data gaps amid hurricane season
news.description: Peak hurricane season is approaching, and the National Weather Service is operating with a less experienced workforce and gaps in some data that forecasters rely on. Last year, the government agency eliminated about 15% of its workforce as part of the Trump administration's sweeping job cuts. Environmental policy expert Tracy Wholf joins "The Daily Report" with more.

news.title: Charlie Kirk shooting suspects' former roommate interview released
news.description: In the pretrial hearing of Tyler Robinson, accused of killing conservative activist Charlie Kirk, prosecutors played an interview with Tyler Robinson's former roommate and romantic partner on Thursday.

news.title: Charlie Kirk murder suspect said "he wishes he hadn't done it," roommate says
news.description: Lance Twiggs said in a recorded interview with a Utah prosecutor that he saw Robinson the day after Charlie Kirk was shot and killed.

news.title: North Texas aviation pioneer Wally Funk dies, aged 87
news.description: Wally Funk was selected in 1961 as one of the elite women in the Mercury 13 program, finishing the same rigorous training program given to the Mercury 7 astronauts.

news.title: Alibaba probe unearthed evidence it knowingly let dangerous drugs be sold to U.S. consumers
news.description: For eight years, Chinese online retailer Alibaba and its U.S. payment processing company failed to prevent dangerous drugs, chemicals and pill presses from being sold to American customers -- even after employees warned of compliance problems, public records show.

news.title: Maine Democrats navigating uncharted waters as Graham Platner says he will step down
news.description: Maine is a key state in the Democratic Party's plan to win back the U.S. Senate. But that plan is in trouble as the state's Democrats are scrambling to replace nominee Graham Platner, who is not going quietly.

news.title: Unstable NYC building case may make converting offices into apartments harder
news.description: The unstable midtown Manhattan building which faced the threat of collapse earlier this week may make it harder for developers to convert office spaces into apartment buildings in the future and raise insurance prices, according to the Wall Street Journal. Neil Osnato, founder of Persistence Analytics Group, joins The Takeout to discuss.

news.title: U.S. and Iran escalate strikes, nudging gas prices higher
news.description: The U.S. and Iran have begun the most intense fighting since President Trump struck a deal for talks three weeks ago. The U.S. hit around 90 targets in Iran overnight, and Iran responded with ballistic missiles and drones aimed at U.S. bases and military assets in the region. Nancy Cordes has more.

news.title: Democratic, GOP strategists on scramble to replace Platner, Blackburn's fortune cookie ad and more
news.description: Maine Democrats are scrambling to replace Graham Platner after he ended his U.S. Senate campaign. Political strategists Chuck Rocha and Mark Bednar join with analysis.

news.title: Daughter of pastor released from Chinese prison recounts being reunited with her father
news.description: Pastor Ezra Jin has landed safely in the U.S. after being released from a Chinese prison where he spent more than 250 days for running an unregistered church. His daughter, human rights activist Grace Jin Drexel, joins The Takeout to share his story.

news.title: Investigators dispute Brian Hooker's account of his wife's disappearance in the Bahamas
news.description: According to Lynette Hooker's family, the story her husband Brian has been telling about the night she went missing in the Bahamas is apparently not what investigators believe actually happened. Cristian Benavides has the update.

news.title: Iran and U.S. ramp up tit-for-tat strikes as Khamenei laid to rest
news.description: Iran's former Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei was buried amid an escalating exchange of fire on the 132nd day of the war.

news.title: ICE officer who fatally shot Mexican man in Houston was not wearing body camera
news.description: The Department of Homeland Security said officers in the field office in Houston were not yet equipped with them.

news.title: Former coach at Bucknell University charged in death of freshman football player
news.description: Former strength and conditioning coach Mark Kulbis was charged Monday in the death of Calvin "CJ" Dickey Jr., a freshman athlete with sickle-cell trait who collapsed during training in July 2024.

news.title: Former Olympian pleads not guilty in reflecting pool vandalism charge
news.description: Canoeist David Hearn plead not guilty in D.C. Superior Court Thursday to a charge of destruction of property causing more than $1,000 in damage to the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool.

news.title: 'Solo agers' are a growing group. Changes that would help them could help everyone
news.description: Many older adults navigate aging on their own — without children or a spouse. An expert says this is "a reality to be supported" rather than a crisis to be solved.

news.title: Class action suit against AI makers over deepfake child sexual abuse material expands
news.description: New plaintiffs in a lawsuit against Elon Musk's SpaceXAI and Stability AI say the companies' AI tools were used to make sexually explicit images of them as children.

news.title: Vermont is creating a statewide trail, and making sure it's accessible to all
news.description: Mountain bike enthusiasts have been working for years on an ambitious 485-mile, multi-use trail called The Velomont that will span the length of the state. They're making sure it's friendly for people with disabilities, particularly cyclists.

news.title: A new kind of robot swims the seas and soars the skies
news.description: Inspired by diving birds, roboticists built the lightweight machines to move from water to air. The design may one day lead to robots that can monitor and sample the coastal ocean.

news.title: EPA proposes weakening heavy-duty truck pollution rules
news.description: The Trump EPA calls Biden-era rules for cutting pollution from heavy trucks "unworkable." The proposed changes have been celebrated by trucking groups and denounced by environmental groups.

news.title: How to deal with seesawing gas prices
news.description: Gas prices have fluctuated since the U.S. and Israel launched a war on Iran, which disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and left consumers unsure of what they'll pay at the pump.

news.title: Smithsonian chief emphasizes 'accuracy and integrity' after White House report
news.description: The memo from the Smithsonian's secretary, Lonnie Bunch, responded to a White House report that calls the National Museum of American History driven by "a radical, activist ideology."

news.title: France downs Morocco 2-0 to advance to the World Cup semifinal
news.description: Morocco was no match for France, which lost 2-0. The French, one of the pre-tournament favorites, move on to the World Cup semifinals against either Spain or Belgium.
